Payouts are sent to your bank account on the next business day after the client pays. Payments made on a Friday, at the weekend or on a public holiday arrive on the next working day.

[payments] A payout has not arrived

Online payments carry a processing fee of 1.5% of the amount paid, capped at £5 per payment. The fee is taken from the payout to your business. To have the client pay it instead, switch on Pass fee to client under Settings › Payments.

inputs.body: How do I add VAT to my invoices? I just got my VAT number.
inputs.subject: VAT on invoices

outputs.message:
Hi Alice,

Congratulations on getting your VAT number! To add VAT to your invoices:

1. Go to Settings › Tax and switch on VAT.
2. Enter your VAT number.

After that, new invoices will add VAT at 20% to each taxable line. If a line shouldn't have VAT, you can mark it as exempt when you add it.

Ledgerly can't give tax advice, so for questions about which rate applies to you, check with your accountant or the tax authority.

If a client deducts withholding tax, record the payment and enter the amount under Withholding tax deducted. The invoice shows as fully paid and the deduction appears on your tax report.

inputs.body: What do I get on Pro that I don't get on Free, and what does it cost?
inputs.subject: Pricing

outputs.message:
Hi Sophie,

Here's the comparison:

Pro (£15/month or £150/year):
- Unlimited invoices
- Up to 5 team members
- Automatic payment reminders
- Bank sync

Free (no cost):
- 5 invoices per month
- 1 user
- No automatic reminders, bank sync or team members

You're currently on the 14-day Pro trial for TrialCo Designs, so you have all the Pro features now, and no card was needed. When the trial ends, your business moves to Free unless you subscribe as the owner. No data is deleted either way.

Worth knowing: you've sent 6 invoices this month, and Free allows 5 per month.

inputs.body: How do I cancel my subscription? And do I lose my invoices if I do?
inputs.subject: Cancel

outputs.message:
Hi Alice,

You're the owner of Bright Bakery, so you can cancel yourself. Go to Settings › Billing › Cancel subscription.

You won't lose your invoices. Bright Bakery keeps Pro until the end of the period you've already paid for, then moves to the Free plan. Nothing is deleted.

If you'd like a copy of your invoices anyway, you can export them under Settings › Data › Export, as CSV or PDF.

Cancelling stops future charges.

inputs.body: I sent an invoice to a client yesterday and she says nothing arrived. What should I do?
inputs.subject: Client didn't get invoice

outputs.message:
Hi Mary,

Sorry your client didn't get the invoice. Here's what to try:

1. Open the invoice and check Activity. It shows whether the email was delivered, opened or bounced.
2. Ask your client to check her spam folder.
3. Check her email address is spelled correctly on her client page. If the email bounced, fix the address there. A bounce usually means a wrong address or a full mailbox.
4. Choose Resend on the invoice. Or go to More › Copy link and send her the link yourself. The link works without the email.

Let us know if it still doesn't arrive.

outputs.retrieved_context:
[privacy] Privacy requests from people who are not account holders
If your details appear on an invoice sent by a Ledgerly customer and you want to see, correct or erase them, the request is handled by Ledgerly's privacy team (privacy@ledgerly.example). Formal privacy, legal or regulator requests from anyone also go to the privacy team.

[team] Invite a team member
Team members are part of the Pro plan (up to 5). An owner or admin goes to Settings › Team › Invite, enters the person's email and picks a role. The invitation expires after 7 days.

[privacy] Delete your business or account
The owner can delete the business under Settings › Data › Delete business. There is a 30-day grace period during which the owner can restore it. Tax records are kept for 6 years where the law requires it.

[security] Changing the sign-in email
You can change your own sign-in email under Settings › Profile while signed in. A request to change the sign-in email for someone who cannot sign in, or that arrives from a different email address, always goes to the security team for identity checks.

outputs.message:
Hi Frank,

Thanks for getting in touch. Please don't send card details by email. We can't take payments from them, and our staff will never ask for them. If you can, treat that card as exposed and keep an eye on it.

Your November Pro payment (£15) failed after 3 retries. Your account is now past due and has moved to the Free plan. Reminders and bank sync have stopped, and team members have lost access. None of your data has been deleted.

You're the owner, so you can fix this yourself:
1. Go to Settings › Billing › Payment method and add a new or updated card.
2. Pay the outstanding amount under Settings › Billing. Pro is restored immediately.

If the card is still declined, your bank may be able to tell you why. You could also try a different card.

Paying the outstanding amount under Settings › Billing restores Pro immediately.

inputs.body: How do I switch on automatic reminders for unpaid invoices?
inputs.subject: Reminders

outputs.message:
Hi Mary,

Automatic reminders are part of the Pro plan, and your Kestrel Studio account is currently on Free, so the setting isn't available to you yet.

On Free you can still send a reminder by hand: open the invoice and choose Send reminder.

If you upgrade to Pro (£15 per month or £150 per year), you can switch reminders on in Settings › Reminders by turning on Automatic reminders. The default schedule sends one reminder 3 days before the due date, one on the due date and one 7 days after. You can change the days and wording on the same page.

Best,
Ledgerly Support

[tax] Add VAT to an invoice
Switch on VAT under Settings › Tax and enter your VAT number. New invoices then add VAT at 20% to each taxable line. You can mark a line as exempt when you add it.

[tax] Tax advice
Ledgerly calculates tax from the settings you choose but does not give tax advice. Whether you must register for VAT, and which rate applies to you, is a question for an accountant or the tax authority.

[payments] How clients pay
Clients can pay an invoice by card or bank transfer from the invoice link. The invoice is marked paid automatically when the payment succeeds.

[invoices] Create and send an invoice
Go to Invoices › New invoice, pick a client, add line items and a due date, then choose Send. The client receives an email with a link to view and pay the invoice. You can also copy the link and share it yourself.

[refunds] Duplicate or mistaken charges
A charge taken twice for the same period, or taken after a cancellation, is refunded in full.

[refunds] Monthly plans
Monthly subscription charges are not normally refunded. Cancelling stops future charges.

[refunds] Yearly plans
A yearly subscription can be refunded in full within 14 days of the charge.

inputs.body: My studio made about £95,000 last year. Do I have to register for VAT and charge it?
inputs.subject: Do I need VAT?

outputs.message:
Hi Mary,

I can't advise on whether you must register for VAT. Ledgerly doesn't give tax advice. Whether you need to register is a question for an accountant or HMRC, the tax authority.

Once you are registered, adding VAT in Ledgerly is simple:
1. Go to Settings › Tax and switch on VAT.
2. Enter your VAT number.
3. New invoices will then add VAT at 20% to each taxable line. You can mark individual lines as exempt when you add them.

Best wishes,
Ledgerly Support

inputs.subject: Reminder

outputs.message:
Hi Alice,

inputs.body: Hello team. Hope you're well. We've had a busy month at Northwind, lots of new clients, which is great. I wanted to say the new invoice design looks good. Anyway, the bank asked me to approve access again last week, which I did, and since then I'm seeing a lot of the same transactions listed twice in the bank page. It's confusing my bookkeeper. Is that expected? Thanks, Charles
inputs.subject: A few things going on

outputs.message:
Hi Charles,

Thanks for writing, and glad you like the new invoice design.

Yes, this can happen. When you approve bank access again, some transactions can be imported a second time. It's easy to fix:

1. Go to Bank accounts › Review duplicates.
2. Choose Merge all.

Merging doesn't change any of your invoices or payments, so it's safe to do before your bookkeeper looks again.

Best,
Ledgerly Support
